🌟ResAdapter 非官方工作流程 [V.1.0]🌟

ComfyUI节点为SD1.5型号应用ResAdapter Unet补丁。

:: 非官方节点 :: >https://github.com/blepping/ComfyUI-ApplyResAdapterUnet

- 安装节点 > 加载 ComfyUI

SDXL :: > 对于 SDXL，您只需要 LoRA（据我所知），因此不需要专用节点：只需像往常一样加载 LoRA 即可。你不需要这个仓库。

o.en:
🌟ResAdapter Unofficial Workflow [V.1.0]🌟

ComfyUI node to apply the ResAdapter Unet patch for SD1.5 models.

:: unfficial node :: >https://github.com/blepping/ComfyUI-ApplyResAdapterUnet

- Install node > Load ComfyUI

SDXL :: > For SDXL, you only need the LoRA (as far as I know) so a dedicated node is unnecessary: just load the LoRA as usual. You don't need this repo.
